As you know, the borrower has requested a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral on our $8 million term loan. Before I can record any final terms, I need each of you to walk through your findings — risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management. Jonas, I'll be looking to you specifically for the covenant-testing findings and the applicable workout policy citation so I can include those sources in the meeting minutes. Let's work through this systematically so we land on the right treatment.
